title: Generalize conditions and failures, not isolated wins
description: A reusable empirical lesson should state the surface, attacker privileges, target configuration, attempted mechanism, observed result and counterexamples. Preserve refusals and failed attempts as evidence when comparing conditions.
when_to_try: Proposing a run-local observation for the shared knowledge base.
prerequisites: Reviewable run and step references, with sensitive or target-specific details removed.
Repeated controlled trials before describing effectiveness as a general pattern.
limitations: This is a curation principle; the initial library contains no locally validated cross-application effectiveness claims.
A refusal describes the tested request and conditions, not the security of an entire attack surface.

sources.note: The supplied research distinguishes published results, anecdotes, hypotheses and proposed experiments.
